newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Shell shuts 11,000-TPD cracker Aug 2 for 21-days.
newsitem.headline: Shell shuts 11,000-TPD cracker Aug 2 for 21-days.

text.p: Shell Singapore has shut its 11,000 tonne per day (82,000 barrel per day) thermal gas oil complex on Saturday for a scheduled 21-day maintenance, a company spokeswoman said on Monday.
"The thermal gas oil unit was shut down on Saturday for 21 days maintenance," she said.
The thermal cracker processes heavy residue into mainly fuel oil and kerosene and gas oil.
In March, Shell shut down half of the complex for six days for de-coking.
Shell earlier said it is still maintaining an around 15 percent output at its 435,000-bpd refinery due to poor margins and high middle distillater stocks.
